title: Group vs Group Deathmatch
description: Group vs Group Deathmatch — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Pwnston L33tenant

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Speak with the Pwnston L33tenant. He will allow entrance to Group vs Group Deathmatch!

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Pwnston L33tenant

Repeatable: No

Zone: Pwnston

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Speak with the Pwnston L33tenant. He will allow entrance to Group vs Group Deathmatch!

Offer:

Group vs Group Deathmatch consists of two teams with up to five Dungeon Runners per team in a face off to the death... and resurrection... and death... and resurrection.... for seven minutes. The team that racks up the most points wins! Seek the L33tenant for entrance to these titillating matches.

Turn-in:

Come to prove your worth versus other Dungeon Runners? You have found the right place!

Level range: 1–100
